values.note: City of Audubon: electric/water sites $15 a night or $375 a month; full hookup sites $20 a night or $450 a month. Paid before camping. Read 2026-11-03.

note: City of Audubon park campground (1108 E Division St) beside the Albert the Bull statue, with a shelter house with fireplace and electricity; on the 21-mi T-Bone Trail, next to the pool, track and ballfields. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 E/W - $20 full hookup (monthly $375/$450), 40 sites 30/50-amp, 48-ft limit, no reservations, season 3rd week of April to 3rd weekend of October. Showers/flush toilets/dump left as recorded (the city page doesn't mention them). Pin ~85 m north of the angled RV pads (fine). Not waterfront confirmed.
